_about: A mapping says, for everything of ours that a part names, what it is in your org. Copy this file, run describe_capability.py for the list to fill in, and give it to adapt_capability.py. Keys that start with an underscore are notes and are ignored. This example is the one in examples/acme/: our policy trigger fitted to an invented Acme_Policy__c.
_only: Optional. Narrow the work to these components and the code they need (Type:Name, as describe_capability.py prints them). Leave it out to adapt the whole part.
_prefix: Optional. What the copies are called in place of Antsurance. Left out, the adapter takes the prefix your org's classes share from org-conventions.json, when the preflight was sure of one.
_testNames: Optional: 'Test at the end' (AcmeThingTest), '_Test at the end' (AcmeThing_Test) or 'Test at the start' (TestAcmeThing). Left out, org-conventions.json decides.
_objects: Each of our objects the part names needs one of: {"to": "Your_Object__c"}, {"createOurs": true} to install our object beside yours, or {"leaveOut": true}. A standard object (Account, Case) is yours already and needs no line.
_fields: Each of our fields the part names, as Object.Field, needs one of: {"to": "Your_Object__c.Your_Field__c"}, {"createOurs": true} to add our field to your object, or {"leaveOut": true}. Beside "to" you may give "type" (your field's type, when no pulled metadata is at hand) and "childRelationship" (the name your lookup gives the list of children, such as Acme_Policies__r). A field of an object that is created or left out goes the same way without a line.
_recordTypes: Each record type of ours the part names, as Object.Name, needs one of: {"to": "Object.Your_Record_Type"}, {"toFieldValue": {"field": "Object.Field", "value": "..."}} when you tell such records apart by a field and not a record type, or {"leaveOut": true}. The policy trigger names none.
_picklistValues: For each picklist the part names values of: our value, then yours. null means you have no such value, and the adapter marks every line that uses it for a decision.
